name: hw-box-label
title: Hand-Drawn Box Label
description: A rounded hand-drawn box that draws on (or drops in with a squash) around one phrase, sized to the measured phrase. Ships the hw-boil and hw-box helpers for hosts that frame their own content.

controls.name: entrance
controls.drives: how the box arrives: stroke draw-on + label fade, or the landing squash (drop-in, contact squash on the deform wrapper, label counter-scaled to net identity, bouncy spring recovery) — travel/duration derived, never exposed

controls.name: strokeType
controls.drives: authored stroke texture on the box path (per-type constants: blur, dry-marker dash, seeded spray dots); draw-on composes via the mask clone

controls.name: labelPos
controls.drives: label placement: above the box or vertically centered inside it

controls.name: boil
controls.drives: boil amp/rot as authored pairs over the family-locked frameDrop 3; seed locked

variables.label: Entrance
variables.description: draw: the box draws on and the phrase fades in; drop: box and phrase drop in and land with a squash.

variables.label: Stroke
variables.description: Texture of the box line: plain, soft, sharp or spray.

variables.label: Boil
variables.description: Hand-drawn jitter: off, calm or lively.
